PR #422 is open: https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/422

Summary of what was done:

**Finding 1 (Medium) — Cost ceiling breach alert**: Both findings still matched live code. Added `checkCostCeilingBreaches()` + pure `classifyCostBreach()` to `cost-guard.ts`, wired into the existing daily `/api/internal/metric-alerts/run` cron as a 5th consumer alongside the other notify-only checks already sharing that job — reusing the exact pattern the finding recommended rather than building new infrastructure.

**Finding 2 (High) — Free-tier spend cap**: Confirmed every org is created via `provisionOrganisation()` as `plan: "free"` with no default cap. Added `defaultMonthlyCostCapUsdForPlan(plan)` ($20/mo for free, null for any other tier) applied only at org-creation time — existing orgs untouched.

Verified: full test suite (1426 pass/0 fail, including 2 new unit-test files), clean typecheck, clean lint, green build, and guardrail-presence check unaffected. PROGRESS.md and `ai-os/boss/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml` updated per repo protocol.
